description: Repair lint findings one change at a time. Compare pixels for each candidate, skip visual changes with reasons, and validate the final result before writing. dryRun never writes.

dryRun.description: Inspect and validate without writing (default false)

fixes.description: Selected fix types (default all supported types)

out.description: Output path (default: <name>.repaired.riv next to the source; the source is never overwritten)

name: riv_repair
title: Repair safe .riv lint findings
